de:

Hip-Hop-Tanz
Um den Ball zu eröffnen, präsentiert die Kompanie Pyramid "Trajectoires". KOSTENLOS

en:

Thursday, May 29, 5pm - Neufchâtel-Hardelot sliding base
FREE - OPEN TO ALL
Duration: 1 hour
https://www.compagnie-pyramid.com/

- AMOR
Cie Bilbobasso
A couple in an arena, transforming everyday scenes into fiery fireworks, with a touch of tango. This is what the Bilbobasso company has to offer in their explosive show
Thursday, May 29, 10pm - BOULOGNE-SUR-MER - Place Dalton
FREE
Duration: 30 minutes
http://www.bilbobasso.com/

Choreographic piece - Cie Dyptik
The Dyptik company will unveil Mirage, a choreographic piece that shakes up codes and fuses traditional musical cultures.

saturday May 31 at 4pm Ecole de danse d'Outreau and 5pm Mirage Show
OUTREAU - Parc du Mont Soleil
FREE
